top.hero-p: Oxidised, kundan, AD stone and terracotta jewellery for college, office, Pujo and weddings. Nothing here is real gold or silver, and nothing costs more than ₹2,500. Come and try it with your saree, or ask for photos on WhatsApp.

photo3.alt: Gold-plated hoop jhumkas with stone work and coin drops hanging against red cloth

budget.h2: Tell us how much you want to spend.
budget.p: Most people come with a number in mind. Here is what that number buys. Prices are fixed and printed on every card, so there is no bargaining at the counter.

shop.h2: Pick a type. See what it costs.
shop.p: These are the starting prices for each kind of piece. Bigger sizes and heavier stone work cost a little more. Ask on WhatsApp and we send photos of what is in stock today.

photo.alt: A pair of round kundan earrings with green and maroon stones and pearl drops

shop.p2: Our biggest counter. About 400 designs on the wall at any time, all on cards with the price written.

photo2.alt: A kundan choker with green beads and a matching pair of earrings laid on dark blue cloth

shop.p3: Imitation kundan and American diamond (AD) stone on a gold-plated base. They look heavy and weigh very little.

photo3.alt: Rows of glass churi on a rack in green, purple, blue, yellow, pink and red

shop.p4: Sizes 2.2, 2.4, 2.6 and 2.8 in stock. Not sure of your size? Bring one bangle that fits and we measure it.

photo4.alt: An oxidised choker of small metal flowers worn on the neck

shop.p5: Dark silver-look pieces made of brass or alloy. No silver in them. They go well with cotton, handloom and kurtis.

photo5.alt: A necklace of bright painted beads with a brass fan-shaped pendant lying on green palm leaves

shop.p6: Handmade pieces from Bankura, Bishnupur and Bolpur. Each one is a little different, so ask for a photo of the exact piece.

photo6.alt: A small pair of oxidised studs with green and pink stones on white cloth

shop.p7: Small things for every day, and the hair pieces a bride or a dancer needs.

items.li: Book 7 days ahead with the rent paid. The deposit is paid on pickup.
The deposit comes back in full, in cash or UPI, when the set is returned.

order.msg: Didi, red saree for my cousin’s wedding. Jhumka and bangles, within ₹400?
order.msg3: ₹390 + ₹50 courier = ₹440. UPI number is this one. It goes out tomorrow.
order.h2: Four messages and it is on its way.

items.h3: Say what you need and your budget
items.p: The occasion, the colour of the dress and how much you want to spend. A photo of the saree helps.
Real photos taken at the counter that day, not catalogue pictures. Usually within 30 minutes during shop hours.
Send your address and bangle size. We send the total with courier. Pay by UPI and send the screenshot.
Packed in a hard box with bubble wrap. Kolkata in 1 to 2 days, the rest of West Bengal in 3 to 5 days.

wholesale.h2: Selling from home or a stall? Buy by the dozen.
wholesale.p: Many of our buyers sell on WhatsApp groups, at Pujo stalls and in their own para. Wholesale price starts from a bill of ₹2,000.

items.li: Minimum bill ₹2,000. You can mix items to reach it.
A dozen can be 12 different designs of the same item.
We send a photo of every dozen before you pay.
GST bill given. Courier at actual cost.
Unsold stock is not taken back. Damaged pieces are replaced if you tell us within 3 days.

facts.h2: What it is, how long it lasts, and the exchange rule.

items.li: This is imitation jewellery. There is no gold or silver in any piece.
Gold-plated means a thin gold-colour polish on brass or alloy.
Oxidised means a dark silver-look finish on brass or alloy.
AD means American diamond, a machine-cut glass-like stone.
Skin reacts to metal? Ask for the nickel-free cards.
Polish on a daily chain lasts 3 to 6 months. On pieces worn a few times a year, much longer.
Keep it away from water, sweat and perfume. Put it on last, take it off first.
Store each piece in the zip pouch we give, away from air.
Loose stone? We fix it at the counter for ₹10.
Exchange within 7 days with the bill, if the piece is unused and on its card.
No cash refund. You take another piece or a credit slip valid for 3 months.
Nose pins and sale items are not exchanged.
Broken in courier? Send an unboxing video within 24 hours and we replace it free.

items.p: I sent a photo of my green Dhakai at 2 pm. By 2:30 I had four photos of earrings laid on a green cloth, with prices. I paid ₹450 and it reached Barasat in two days.
We rented the full bridal set for my sister. ₹800 for three days and the deposit came back the same hour we returned it. Nobody at the wedding could tell.
